entities.name: Hermogenes of Priene
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hermogenes of Priene was a Hellenistic architect, best known for designing a temple of Artemis Leukophryene (Artemision) at Magnesia in Lydia, an Ionian colony on the banks of the Maeander river in Anatolia.
